name: Basic Apple Pie
description: A traditional apple pie with optional variations using brown sugar, honey, nuts, or raisins.
steps: Combine sliced apples with cinnamon sugar.
Fill pie crust with apple mixture.
Optional: If apples are juicy, add 1 tbsp flour to filling.
variations: Replace sugar mix with brown sugar, honey, raisins, or nuts.
Can mix multiple variation ingredients together.
